mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity(title, description, location, start_time, end_time, signup_start, signup_end, image_url, visible_to_team, fee_rule, creator_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{signupStart}, #{signupEnd}, #{imageUrl}, #{visibleToTeam}, #{feeRule}, #{creatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM activity WHERE creator_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM activity WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
